title: Custom bbcode tag (RichTextEffect) with custom fonts shows broken glyphs
body:
### Tested versions

- Tried this in `4.3.stable` and `4.2.stable`

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.26100 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900HX (32 Threads)

### Issue description

When loading a custom font in a `RichTextEffect`, the font fails to display properly.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/34283528-f75f-42b0-894e-0c2fb7d197a1)

**Effect code:**
```gdscript
@tool
class_name RichTextCustomFont
extends RichTextEffect

var font: FontFile = load('res://fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf')
var bbcode := "custom_font"


func _process_custom_fx(char_fx: CharFXTransform) -> bool:
	char_fx.font = font
	return true

```

### Relevant Information

* According to the docs, `char_fx.font` is of type `RID`. When doing `font.get_rid()` in this code, it returns `RID(0)`.
* But if I print the loaded font resource, I do get a `<FontFile#-9223368675321381674>`
* The default `char_fx.font` also prints an `RID(933841854267425)`
* Seems like _any_ font assignment triggers this. It also happens if I assign `char_fx.font = ThemeDB.fallback_font`
* I tried passing the fonts from another script, as `@export` variables, from an autoload. All failed and return `RID(0)`
* I had read somewhere that Godot initialized the fonts lazily, so I also tried loading the font, and adding it to an object inside the tree, and then reference it. Same thing.
* Doing `[font=res://same-path-to/font.tff]custom font[/font]` does work as intended.


### Steps to reproduce

* Create a `RichTextEffect` that loads a font
* Add it to a `RichTextLabel` with bbcode enabled, and use that effect

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)


[richtexteffect-font.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18633471/richtexteffect-font.zip)
